intro: One hotdog is roughly 300 kcal (estimate). Most of the calories come from the high-fat sausage and the white bun.
diet: Yes, one hotdog still fits as a snack or light breakfast. But it's low in protein compared to fat, so it's not very filling. Sausage is also processed food, so better to have it once in a while. Try not to eat two or three in one go.
tips: Pick a regular-size chicken sausage, not jumbo or cheese-filled.
Go easy on mayo. Use mustard or chilli sauce instead.
Pair it with a boiled egg or unsweetened milk for protein.

swap.name: Egg / chicken sandwich
swap.why: About the same calories, but more protein and less processed fat.

faq.q: What are hotdog sausages made of?
faq.a: Usually minced chicken or beef mixed with flour, salt and flavouring. Check the label for halal status.

faq.q: Can I pack hotdogs in my kid's lunchbox?
faq.a: Once in a while, sure. Add some fruit or veg on the side so the meal is more balanced.

faq.q: Do I need to cook the sausage even though it's pre-cooked?
faq.a: Yes, heat it until properly hot before eating, for food safety.
